desc: Derive and implement the monotonic-stack boundaries for the minimum contribution (L = nearest strictly smaller, R = nearest smaller-or-equal) so equal values are counted once.
Implement O(1) counting of subarrays of length at most k containing i via count_pairs(A, B, k-1) handling saturation (m>=A+B) and the diagonal cut.
Reuse min_sum on negated nums to obtain the maximum contribution as -min_sum(-nums).
Verify against provided examples (20 and -6), plus brute force on small arrays, k=1, k=n, all-equal, negatives, and duplicates.
